changesApplied.changeMade: Added color prop to ProgressBar component: color={getStatusColor(activity.progress.percentage)}
changesApplied.reason: Enforces specification requirement that ALL progress bars use color coding (green <60%, yellow 60-85%, red >=85%). Provides consistent visual feedback across context, activity, and memory indicators.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Minimal blast radius - single property addition to existing component. No breaking changes. Uses existing getStatusColor() function. Visual impact: activities now show color-coded progress (green=on track, yellow=approaching limit, red=at capacity).

colorCodedProgressBars.evidence: All progress bars (context, activities, memory) now use getStatusColor() with correct thresholds

memorySectionConditional.evidence: Memory section only renders when impulseCount > 0 (line 243)

taskCounterFormat.evidence: Task counter displays as 'Task N/M' format (line 230)

impulseLoadingState.evidence: Displays 'X/Y loaded' format with 2.5s polling updates (lines 251-253)

tokenBudgetUpdates.evidence: Shows usedTokens/totalBudget with progress bar, updates via 2.5s polling (lines 255-258)

activityProgressTracking.evidence: Shows progress percentage, task counter, elapsed time, and color-coded progress bar (lines 227-234)

architecturalNotes.pollingVsRealtime: Current implementation uses 2.5s polling for 'real-time' updates. True real-time would require WebSocket/SSE. Current latency is acceptable for human monitoring per documented architecture decision.
